Select molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, target_type, tax_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activity rows for target CHEMBL4282. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter to standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', pchembl_value not null, target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, and tax_id 9606. Do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id.
